matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 21 August 1996 entered in District Court Galle in Partition case No.2367/P Nimal, Sunil, Aruni and Kusum were allotted with 5/12th,5/12th, 1/12th and 1/12th shares respectively from and out of divided and defined lots 6 and 7 in Partition Plan No.185 dated 23rd June 1995 made by J.W. de Silva Licensed Surveyor By Deed of Transfer. No.346 dated 6th June 1998 attested by Ranjith Perera Notary Public Nimal purchased the 1/12th share of Aruni. Nimal was married to Nalini and had 3 children namely Amal, Bimal and Krishni. Nimal had a daughter named Achini by his first wife Malini, Nimal died intestate on 23rd April 2008. Within a year thereafter Nalini too died intestate. Nimal's son Bimal who was married to Amali died on 4th of March 2010 having met with an accident and issueless.
